assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - management of change not applied to PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4210 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 19 December 2017 a planned critical control verification of PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the in-service inspection of pressure equipment not effective.
